descriptor: Family-run removals across the north of England

voice.summary: Haul & Hum talks like a friendly northern crew chief who has seen every wardrobe and sofa. It is warm and a bit cheeky, gives fixed prices and always mentions the tea break.
dos: Give prices and van sizes plainly
Use friendly northern English, not slang
Refer to the crew by what they do
donts: Do not hide the price behind 'get a quote'
Do not use corporate logistics words

taglines: Your whole life, one organised van
Careful crews, fixed prices, tea included
boilerplate: Haul & Hum Movers is a family-run removals firm serving the north of England with careful crews, fixed prices and an instant online estimate.

microcopy.success: Estimate ready. A medium van and two crew should do it.
microcopy.error: We cannot reach that postcode yet. Call us on 0161 555 0142.
microcopy.empty: No rooms added yet. Tap plus to start.

logo.note: A box is the unit of every move and sits well in a bold, boxed layout.
